raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advances the matching MCore main pin and submodule from `159b443c3e1a23ff68321973b936fef810bb3c61` to `52fbcbc18c2992db1747a4558f430e0519604ad0` (ten upstream commits).

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/159b443c3e1a23ff68321973b936fef810bb3c61...52fbcbc18c2992db1747a4558f430e0519604ad0) includes inference EOS handling, MFSDP layout validation, SHARP group selection, fused MLA residual metadata, MoE recomputation fixes, NCCL compatibility, and documentation/tooling updates. No Bridge compatibility or dependency changes are needed based on source inspection. The dev pin and Bridge lockfile are unchanged.

Validation: CUDA-container `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` passed (341 packages, no delta); all-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed. Matching main pin/gitlink and unchanged dev pin verified. Commit is signed and DCO-signed-off.

Requested CI: standard gates and L0 on H100/GB200 for the noon maintenance slot. CICD NeMo [run 37828986546, attempt 1](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/37828986546) passed on head `358b10109fdefd68b9748120207349116821c223`: 29 H100 and 12 GB200 L0 jobs plus all four unit jobs succeeded. Configure confirmed L0-only selection (all four extended-tier flags false). Installation and wheel build remain pending, so overall validation and merge are pending.
